stm32u5.constraint: This is a source-backed Rev A0 pinmux intent, not a routed-board release. ERC, DRC, impedance review, NFC matching, and schematic net binding remain release gates.

tropic01.host_policy: TROPIC01 does not initiate communication; host MCU must wait for readiness or use GPO when configured.
tropic01.nu_policy: NU pins must follow the datasheet section 11 connection guidance before routing.
